info.name: DayFlow API
info.description:
Tests every DayFlow backend API.

Run it with the Collection Runner (Run collection) so the requests run in order: Register saves the token and later requests reuse the ids they create.

Each run registers a new user (postman<number>@test.com), so the checks always start from an empty account.

Start the backend first: `python manage.py runserver`. Change `base_url` in the collection Variables tab if your server runs somewhere else.

"Complete Focus Session" waits 61 seconds on purpose, for its 1-minute session to finish.
